proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the alternator label/engraving showing Valeo and the exact part number (M278 / 439741).
Provide a short video of the alternator charging test with voltage readings at idle and at higher RPM (or a diagnostic printout/receipt).
Show the pulley side: close-up of belt groove and a clip spinning the pulley to demonstrate smooth rotation and no wobble/no knock.
Send close-ups of the regulator/brush area and any burn/overheat marks (front and back).
Provide straight-on high-resolution photos of all terminals/connector area to confirm no corrosion, cracks, or looseness.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is an alternator-like unit, but the key details needed to price safely in Abuja (exact make/part number compatibility and verified working condition) are not readable or demonstrated. Without those, any price would be guesswork beyond worst-case.
